answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 71 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The haven register is checked at draw time, wander lists the eligible set, and canyon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 71 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 97 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
